description: Opt-in method-sharing steady-query controls over the unchanged 1000-row fixture. Select with --plan; schedules match the existing binding comparison selections. Direct sharing, literal-pool diversity, eviction and JIT retention use separate diagnostics.

workloads.name: pk_hit
workloads.sql: SELECT score FROM items WHERE id = $1

workloads.name: arithmetic_projection
workloads.sql: SELECT id, (score::i64 * 3 + bucket::i64) / (bucket::i64 + 1) FROM items WHERE bucket >= $1 ORDER BY id

workloads.name: computed_sort
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items ORDER BY score * 3 + bucket DESC, id LIMIT 20

workloads.name: aggregate_argument
workloads.sql: SELECT sum((score * 3 + bucket) / (bucket + 1)) FROM items WHERE bucket >= $1

workloads.name: aggregate_many_groups
workloads.sql: SELECT score % 100, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY score % 100 ORDER BY 1

workloads.name: text_like_fallback
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row5%'
